power.neoorigins.wraith_hunger_drain.des: Mimu itọju ara iwoye rẹ jẹ owo-ori - o mu ebi npa 75% yiyara ju deede lọ.
power.neoorigins.wraith_evolved_phase.de: Yipada: rin nipasẹ awọn bulọọki ti o lagbara pẹlu ọkọ ofurufu lakoko ti o nlọ. 25% din ebi sisan. Obsidian ati bedrock tun ṣe idiwọ fun ọ.
power.neoorigins.wraith_ascended_weaknes: Awọn ọta ti o wa nitosi laarin awọn bulọọki 3 ni o ni ipọnju pẹlu ailagbara.
power.neoorigins.wraith_ascended_dayligh: Imọlẹ oorun tun n jo, ṣugbọn pẹlu idaji kikankikan.
power.neoorigins.wraith_apex_phase.name: Fọọmu Spectral (Apex)
power.neoorigins.wraith_apex_phase.descr: Yipada: rin nipasẹ gbogbo awọn bulọọki ayafi bedrock pẹlu ọkọ ofurufu lakoko gbigbe. Pọọku manna sisan. Ko si ohun ti o le gba o.
power.neoorigins.wraith_apex_hunger_drai: Fọọmu iwoye rẹ ti duro - ebi n fa ni iyara 25% yiyara ju deede.
origins.neoorigins.skeleton.name: Egungun
origins.neoorigins.skeleton.description: Apo ti awọn egungun ti a tun pada - yara, ina, ati apaniyan pẹlu ọrun. Férémù ẹlẹgẹ, ti oorun ti yọ kuro, ati pe o ni anfani lati ni ikun ti awọn ẹran ti o buru julọ.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_undead.name: Àìkú
power.neoorigins.skeleton_undead.descrip: O ko ti ku. Awọn oogun iwosan ṣe ipalara fun ọ, Awọn ohun mimu ipalara mu ọ larada, ati awọn enchantments Smite ṣe ipalara pupọ si ọ.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_water_breathin: Ko nilo lati simi. Le ye laelae labẹ omi.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_marksmanship.d: +2 bibajẹ ajeseku pẹlu awọn ohun ija projectile.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_speed.name: Imọlẹ egungun
power.neoorigins.skeleton_speed.descript: Awọn egungun ṣofo rẹ jẹ ki o yara ni 20% ni awọn ẹsẹ rẹ.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_jump.name: Ìwúwo Fúyẹ́
Awọn egungun ẹlẹgẹ rẹ dinku ilera ti o pọju si awọn ọkan 7.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_daylight_damag: O sun ni orun taara ayafi ti o wọ ibori.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_diet.name: Ounjẹ Egungun
power.neoorigins.skeleton_diet.descripti: O le jẹ ounjẹ egungun nikan, ẹran ti o jẹjẹ, ati oju alantakun.
Ounjẹ egungun jẹ ounjẹ fun ọ.
origins.neoorigins.slime.name: Slime
origins.neoorigins.slime.description: Ẹda gelatinous ti o gbọdọ duro ni omi lati ye. Bounces laiseniyan ni pipa ṣubu, yapa kuro ninu iku nigbati o tutu daradara, o si dagba sii pẹlu iriri.
power.neoorigins.slime_moisture.name: Ọrinrin
power.neoorigins.slime_moisture.descript: O ni ọpa ọrinrin ti o nyọ lori akoko. Drains yiyara ni asale ati nigbati on iná. Duro ninu omi tabi ojo lati rehydrate. Loke 75%: Regen 1. Ni isalẹ 10%: -4 ihamọra. Ni 0%: o baje.
power.neoorigins.slime_death_save.name: Pín
power.neoorigins.slime_death_save.descri: Nigbati o ba ku pẹlu ọrinrin to ju 75% lọ, o pin dipo - teleporting awọn bulọọki 50 kuro pẹlu awọn ọkan meji. Rẹ max HP regenerates pada si deede lori 2 iṣẹju.
power.neoorigins.slime_level_hp.name: Idagbasoke Gelatinous
power.neoorigins.slime_level_hp.descript: + 1 max HP fun awọn ipele iriri 10. Awọn atunto lori iku.
power.neoorigins.slime_no_fall_damage.de: O ko gba ibajẹ isubu - o agbesoke.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_evolved_hp.name: Iṣaṣe pataki
power.neoorigins.abyssal_ascended_swim_s: Ti mu dara si we iyara.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_apex_hp.name: Apex iwulo
power.neoorigins.abyssal_apex_conduit_po: Mimi omi ti o yẹ, iran alẹ, ati Yara - lori ilẹ ati labẹ omi.

power.neoorigins.air_mage_apex_speed.des: Iyara gbigbe ti o ni ilọsiwaju.
